title: a session reads which Claude it is
intention: cairn.tools.base.claude_identity.who() names the Claude session a process runs under: its session name, former names, box and session id, read from Claude Code's own session record.
how: New module cairn/tools/base/claude_identity.py with who(session_id=None, *, sessions_dir=None, environ=None). Read-only and defensive over ~/.claude/sessions/*.json.

clauses.claim: given a session id, who() returns the matching record's name, its formerNames as a list of names, this box's hostname and the id
given no session id, who() finds the record whose pid is CLAUDE_PID from the environment
an unknown id or an absent sessions dir returns name '' with the host still given, and a torn record is skipped, never raised
two records carrying one session id resolve to the one with the newer updatedAt

decisions.text: D1: who(session_id=None, *, sessions_dir=None, environ=None) -> {name: str, former_names: list[str], host: str, session: str}. sessions_dir defaults to $CAIRN_CLAUDE_SESSIONS_DIR or ~/.claude/sessions; environ defaults to os.environ; host is os.uname().nodename. Lookup order: a record whose sessionId == session_id (newest updatedAt on ties); else the record whose pid == int(environ['CLAUDE_PID']); else the records of this process's ancestor pids read from /proc/<pid>/stat (skipped where /proc is absent). Nothing found: name '', former_names [], session = session_id or ''. Never raises.
D2: cairn.tools.base.claude_identity joins public_interface in cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json (through the artifact door).

D3: proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_session_reads_which_claude_it_is.py, one tooth per clause, over a scratch sessions dir from cairn.tools.scratch, house runner (PASS/FAIL per tooth), the import inside each tooth.
